messages:
mei: quick sync on the onboarding hero banner + sample-project cards. uploaded a compact variant to Figma (link). main goal: reduce initial scroll on small screens.

tom: saw it. compact looks good but concerned about discoverability of the sample actions. are we hiding actions behind a chevron?

mei: not hiding. primary action lives on the card surface, visible. overflow chevron only for extra details.

arjun: accessibility nit: make sure cards have descriptive names for screen readers, e.g. aria-label="Open sample project: Weatherbot" and add aria-describedby referencing the 1-line summary.

maria: microcopy recs: change CTA from "Start" to "Open sample project" to be explicit. also change subtitle to "Preconfigured demo with step-by-step quickstart". keeps expectations clear.

tom: layout note: reduce image height to 80px, keep consistent aspect ratio. will update CSS and measurement for virtualization.

accessibility-bot: lint: keyboard order must focus whole card first; if inner controls exist, use roving tabindex or contextual menu. contrast passed for title but helper text in dark mode fails 3:1.

mei: i'll update helper token to --muted-3 for dark. arjun, can you add the aria-describedby in the spec?

arjun: done in the figma notes and added code snippet for reference.

maria: experiment idea: run copy A/B - "Open sample project" vs "Create sample project". track quickstart_started and onboarding_complete.

tom: flagged ENG-4660 for the implementation. i'll post the PR when ready and ping for quick QA. :thumbsup:
